# regulatory-review-planner

> Agent Skill for model-planned compliance review of Chinese policy / regulation / internal-rule drafts: plans review scope, verifies facts via authorized pkulaw MCPs, and outputs a structured review memo with matched text, judgment, basis, source tags and revision suggestions.

Part of the SynomosAI ecosystem. Runs inside WorkBuddy.

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/SKILL.md): skill main file (YAML frontmatter + full method)
- [references/review-taxonomy.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/references/review-taxonomy.md): review layers and items
- [references/tool-integration-policy.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/references/tool-integration-policy.md): MCP policy
- [scripts/split_articles.mjs](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/scripts/split_articles.mjs): article splitter
- [README.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/README.md): Chinese overview
- [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/regulatory-review-planner/blob/main/LICENSE.md): MIT
